scope: A run-only VINS feature filter at min/max Sobel structure-tensor eigenvalue ratio 0.01 was tested against the prior zero-offset hold diagnostic. It rejected weak-anisotropy current left-camera features, then a read-only observer captured the first residual-bearing telemetry sample and target stereo images. The action reached and held the zero-offset goal; localization later exceeded the unchanged normalized-cost limit during the landing sequence. This is not navigation acceptance.

run.qualification: PROVISIONAL zero-offset action/hold diagnostic; not a P5 scenario acceptance

px4_ulog.interpretation: The action succeeded for a zero-offset goal. PX4 entered AUTO_LAND; touchdown was recorded; the final state was disarmed; no DESCEND/failsafe state was recorded. EV fusion flags were present; GNSS aiding flags remained zero. This SITL run does not by itself qualify P5 navigation.

full_observation_analysis.method: Each residual observation is joined by target_stamp_ns and camera side to its captured mono image. For each image, the largest absolute vertical intensity gradient at each x within y=270..419 is fit with an ordinary least-squares line over x=10..629. Signed edge distance and residual projections onto the fitted line tangent and normal are computed. An 11x11 Sobel structure tensor at each target coordinate provides a local minimum-to-maximum eigenvalue ratio as a texture anisotropy descriptor.
full_observation_analysis.interpretation_limit: The fitted strong-edge heuristic was inherited from #206; in this image scene its median feature-to-edge distance is >200 px and no observation is within 1 px, so that edge-proximity comparison is out of scope. Local structure-tensor ratios and exact image/residual matching remain informative for this run.

interpretation.supported: The opt-in filter removed the low-anisotropy candidates in the current left-frame feature set: no captured residual observation in this run had a local 11x11 Sobel tensor ratio below 0.01. The zero-offset action completed and held; the PX4 ULog records EV fusion, zero GNSS aiding, touchdown/disarm and no failsafe transition.
